title: Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 – The Valsad Mahila Nagrik Sahakari Bank Ltd., Valsad, Gujarat – Extension of period
description: The Reserve Bank of India issued Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 to The Valsad Mahila Nagrik Sahakari Bank Ltd., Valsad, Gujarat vide Directive No.AMD.DOS.SSM.No.S831/11-03-153/2025-2026 dated December 17, 2025, for a period of six months up to close of business on June 18, 2026.
